entry.title: Milwaukee Brewers offseason notes: Free agents Arbitration eligibles 40-man adds After a fun October, the offseason is here. Catch up on the Brewers’ to-do list: www.mlb.com/news/brewers...

Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: The World Series champion Brewers have four players who landed among the three finalists for BBWAA awards: Brice Turang: NL MVP Jacob Misiorowski: NL Cy Young Trevor Megill: NL Relief Pitcher of the Year Pat Murphy: NL Manager of the Year www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
Dustin May: Dustin May declined his mutual option with the Brewers and is a free agent

Brice Turang: “You going to let $1 million stand in the way of signing a Hall of Famer?" One of of my favorite tales of the '26 Brewers, from Bob Nightengale early in the season. Did Brice Turang really say it? We got to witness him and Matt Arnold hash it out. www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
